capabilities: Track routine streaks from tagged Daily Note checkboxes
Insert routine task templates from the command palette
Pause routines with freeze days and custom schedules
Embed streak widgets in notes via routine-streaks-widget code blocks
Export data and generate Scriptable code for iOS widgets
extras: Works fully locally with no telemetry; iOS widget data only refreshes when Obsidian exports or recalculates, so it can go stale until the user re-exports.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track recurring routine streaks or show their progress outside the vault, such as on a phone home screen.

relations.evidence: Routine Streaks can generate ready-to-paste Scriptable code for iOS/iPadOS widgets.

summary: Habit streak tracker that computes routine completion from tagged Daily Note checkboxes and exports widget data to Scriptable for iOS home screens.
